title: Guilloché Horology Lace Filigree
subtitle: Rose Engine Cycloid Banknote Tracery
description: High-precision geometric guilloché engine-turned filigree inspired by luxury Swiss watch dials and banknote security tracery. Multi-layer hypotrochoid rosettes create shimmering moiré interference lace.
formulaCompact: x = (R-r)*cos(θ) + d*cos(k*θ + φ),  y = (R-r)*sin(θ) - d*sin(k*θ + φ)
